title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: S&P 500, Nasdaq climb as AI-linked stocks recover ahead of earnings - The Economic Times
text: US Market | Dow Jones Live Updates: US stocks rebound as chip and AI-linked shares recover from a sharp selloff. The Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 rise, while semiconductor stocks lead gains. CoreWeave climbs after a Goldman Sachs upgrade, with SpaceX and Tesla also advancing ahead of a busy earnings week.
